product_metadata.title: Oster Titanium Infused DuraCeramic Griddle with Warming Tray, Black/Crème (CKSTGRFM18W TECO)
features: Electric griddle pan with titanium infused DuraCeramic nonstick coating lasts 8x longer than ordinary nonstick coatings
Natural, PTFE and PFOA free ceramic coating won't flake or peel and cleans easily
Cooks up to 30 percent faster to save time and energy
Removable, adjustable temperature control to accurately set cooking temperature
Convenient warming tray keeps food warm until you are ready to serve
description: Make healthier, family-sized meals with the Oster Titanium Infused DuraCeramic Griddle with Warming Tray. This griddle pan features innovative titanium-infused DuraCeramic nonstick coasting that lasts eight times longer and cooks up to 30 percent faster than ordinary nonstick surfaces, saving you time and energy. The safe and natural ceramic coating is also scratch resistant and PFOA- and PTFE-free, so you can make pancakes, eggs, and more without worry. This durable coating won't flake or peel and wipes clean easily. The large 10- by 18-inch cooking surface allows you to conveniently prepare meals for the entire family, while the included warming tray keeps food at the ideal serving temperature. A removable drip tray catches all the grease for easy cleanup, and cool-touch handles make serving easy and effortless. A removable, adjustable temperature control unit lets you set the cooking temperature accurately, giving you the versatility to cook a wide variety of foods.
